title: South Lenches Parish Council — Neighbourhood Development Plan update
body:
Dear Parishioners

As of October 1st, we have moved into the formal Examination stage of the South Lenches Neighbourhood Development Plan.

You will recall from our previous update that an independent Examiner is appointed by Wychavon District Council to review and examine our current Neighbourhood Plan. What this means in practice is that he looks at the Planning law that governs our Parish - in our case, this is the South Worcestershire Development Plan Review 2026 (the Local Plan) and then the National Planning Policy Framework agreement. His job is to examine our Plan in the context of the Local and National planning laws.

Our Examiner is reading the Policies we have developed and written in the Plan, along with all the corresponding local context and evidence. He is examining to ensure that our Policies are in agreement with the Planning law and guidance laid out in the Local Plan and the National Planning policy Framework. All the detailed documents including the Submission version of our Neighbourhood Plan and Appendices are available for your review on the Wychavon website for the South Lenches Neighbourhood Plan, through this link.

You will also find the formal letter written by our Examiner on his examination process which he is ensuring is transparent and open.

We expect his Examination to take around 4 - 6 weeks, after which point the Parish Council and Wychavon District Council will receive a formal report. We will be updating the Neighbourhood Development Plan with the Examiner's comments and then publishing the Main Modifications to the Neighbourhood Plan. We hope to be able to publish the Main Modifications by early January 2027.

With genuine enthusiasm, we can see the finalised Neighbourhood Development Plan being ready to come to the Parish for a formal Referendum on its adoption by next Spring.

Should you have any questions about the Neighbourhood Plan process, please do make contact and I will be happy to share my knowledge and understanding of this work.

Councillor Carolyn Hodges, chodges@southlenchesparishcouncil.org
